text:
Implemented compatibility updates across boltons and glom:
- Added warning-free argument formatting and verified keyword-only defaults.
- Hardened duplicate-value OneToOne handling and exposed FastIterOrderedMultiDict.
- Fixed reverse set subtraction and multi-operand difference updates.
- Added glom spec and streaming APIs, plus Inspect conflict-resolution fixes.

Validation: API smoke checks pass; 440 existing tests pass. Three unrelated Python/PyYAML compatibility failures and an `ecoutils` import issue remain.

Added requirement confidence estimates in `STATUS.json`.
